guidelines.detail: refines PROC-05 (The detached start event is consistent with the described post-completion follow-up, but that follow-up should be scoped as a separate process. This refines PROC-05 by specifying the appropriate scope when the trigger occurs after the main flow has completed.)

same as LRN-008 (The description identifies the participant’s ordering action as the process initiator, while the records show the generated start event replacing the reference’s separate initiating activity. The wording matches learned guideline LRN-008. )

same as LRN-008 (The description states that a customer places an order to begin the process, while the records show that action represented by a generated start event and no corresponding activity. This guideline is already captured by LRN-008.)

refines FLOW-01 (The validator reports that the start event has no outgoing connection, while the description gives a trigger and subsequent work. FLOW-01 establishes sequence flows for execution order; this guideline specifies that connection for the start of a described process.)

refines FID-01 (The description identifies an order as the object being handed over, while the generated task label substitutes a related entity. This supports a general guideline about preserving described entities in activity labels, refining FID-01's broader instruction to model what the description states.)

same as LRN-016 (The validator reports that the start event has no outgoing connection, while the description gives a process trigger followed by subsequent work. This is already covered by learned guideline LRN-016.)

refines ACT-07 (The description explicitly gives online and phone ordering as alternatives, and the missing flows show the reference routes the start through an exclusive gateway to the corresponding activities. This refines ACT-07 by specifying the gateway type and branching pattern for mutually exclusive initiation channels.)
same as LRN-018 (The description identifies the order as the object being handed over, while the generated label substitutes a different object. LRN-018 already expresses this guideline.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description indicates that optional work may be triggered by an event after the main flow has completed: Model the triggered work as a separate process, rather than as a detached start-to-end chain in the same process.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description indicates that optional work may be triggered by an event after the main flow has completed

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says the process begins when a participant performs an action: Model the process trigger with a start event, then model the described action as an activity after that event; do not use the start event alone to represent the action.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that a participant performs an action that initiates the process

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states a process trigger followed by a subsequent activity: Connect the start event to the first activity with an outgoing sequence flow, preserving the stated execution order.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states a process trigger followed by a subsequent activity

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says that an ongoing activity continues until a stated condition occurs, and then states an outcome that follows: Model waiting for that condition with an intermediate catch event, then continue the flow to the stated outcome.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that an ongoing activity continues until a stated condition occurs, and then states an outcome that follows

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description identifies the object or information entity acted on by an activity: Label the corresponding BPMN activity using that stated entity rather than substituting a related but distinct one.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description identifies the object or information entity acted on by an activity

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that the same process can be initiated through mutually exclusive channels: Model an exclusive gateway that branches to a separate activity for each channel.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that the same process can be initiated through mutually exclusive channels
